about: AUD-34 (autopilot-week audit, 2026-09-23): the 15 commands the in-turn-wait guard refused between 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-23 (hub 13, pe-hub 2). recovered=true is the session transcript text verbatim; false is rebuilt from the journal matched fragment. Project names and home paths are neutralised. verdict local = the guard must NOT refuse it (not a wait, or a wait on the session's own job); external = refused. ownPids = the pids the session announced itself with $! before the call.

items.what: local git: waits for its own handoff commit to land on HEAD
items.command: until git diff --quiet -- docs/handoffs/theme-refactor/phase-01-theme-collapse.md && [ "$(git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD)" = 0 ]; do sleep 10; done

items.what: loopback probe of a dev server the session restarted
items.command: until curl -s -o /dev/null -m 5 http://localhost:8081/status 2>/dev/null; do sleep 5; done

items.what: clock-free counter loop inside docker run … sh -c (#52)
items.command: cd /tmp && docker rm -f dbg1 >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --name dbg1 --log-driver json-file --log-opt max-size=1m --log-opt max-file=2 --memory 64m --network none --read-only busybox:1.36 sh -c 'line=$(head -c 1048576 /dev/zero | tr "\0" "x"); i=0; while [ $i -lt 20 ]; do printf "%s\n" "$line"; i=$((i+1)); done' 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "run-exit=$?"; sleep 3; echo "--- state ---"; docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}} err={{.State.Error}}' dbg1; echo "--- logs (first 200 chars) ---"; docker logs dbg1 2>&1 | head -c 200; echo; echo "--- wait ---"; docker wait dbg1; echo "wait-exit=$?"

items.what: its own push chain, whose command also reads gh — a mixed wait
items.command: until grep -q -E "PUSH_EXIT=0|CHAIN_DONE" /tmp/p9-tb-chain.log 2>/dev/null; do sleep 15; done; grep -E "COMMIT=|PUSH_EXIT|VERIFY_LOCAL_EXIT|CHAIN_DONE|pre-push|failed|error:" /tmp/p9-tb-chain.log | head -8; echo "=== #183 head + CI"; gh pr view 183 -R acme/api --json headRefOid,isDraft -q '"head=\(.headRefOid[0:8]) draft=\(.isDraft)"'; gh run list -R acme/api -b pe/obs-plane -L 3 --json databaseId,workflowName,status,headSha,createdAt -q '.[]|[.databaseId,.workflowName,.status,.headSha[0:8],.createdAt]|@tsv'

items.command:
F=tests/fixtures/plans/lint-f17-spans.md && {
cat <<'HDR'
---
slug: lint-f17-spans
created: 2026-01-01
status: active
phases: 36
handoffs: docs/handoffs/lint-f17-spans/
memory: project_lint-f17-spans

# F17 span-loop fixture — the shape that crashed bash 3.2

The plan that took `--lint` down (#17): 36 phases, each with a §Verification
the F17/F18 span extractors walk span by span, and a phase 36 whose five
command bullets are the reproducer's own — neutral names, the SAME byte
lengths (39 / 170 / 154 / 23 / 101 / 132), because the crash was heap
corruption and the bisect turned on length and count, not on the words.
Truncated to 35 phases it linted OK; with 36 it died in `libsystem_malloc`
with nothing on either stream. It must lint OK, repeatedly, under /bin/bash.

## Phase graph

| Phase | Title | Depends on | Parallel-safe with | Repos | Exit criteria |
|------:|-------|-----------|--------------------|-------|---------------|
HDR
i=1
while [ $i -le 36 ]; do
  if [ $i -eq 1 ]; then dep="—"; else dep=$((i - 1)); fi
  printf '| %d | Step %d | %s | — | web-frontend | checked |\n' "$i" "$i" "$dep"
  i=$((i + 1))
done
echo
i=1
while [ $i -le 35 ]; do
  cat <<PH

### Phase $i — Step $i

- **Size:** S
- **Verification:**
  - **Verify in:** web-frontend
  - \`pnpm vitest run src/features/step-$i src/components/step-$i src/hooks\`
  - \`git log --oneline -1\`
  - \`test "\$(ls src/features/step-$i/*.tsx 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 4\`
PH
  i=$((i + 1))
done
cat <<'P36'

### Phase 36 — Step 36

- **Size:** S
- **Verification:**
  - **Verify in:** widgets/web-frontend
  - `pnpm vitest run src/components/waybar src/panels src/features/asset-catalogue src/components/action-palette src/features/firstrun src/features/walkthrough src/hooks`
  - `test "$(ls src/panels/{summaries,filters,saved-searches,drafts-orders,deal-stages,indicators}/\[id\]/index.tsx 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 6`
  - `pnpm verify:local`
  - `gh pr checks pe/web-frontend-audit-remediation-p36 -R ExampleOrg/widget-web-frontend --required`
  - `python3 ../../scripts/audits-coverage-check.py --status ../../docs/audits/sept/web-frontend/remediation-status.yaml --phase 36`
P36
} > "$F" && awk 'NR>=1 && /Verify in:\*\* widgets/,0 { printf "%d\n", length($0) }' "$F" && wc -l "$F"
